To start understanding your natural rhythm in training, what aspect of physical movement brings you the most satisfaction during your sessions?
Options: [Explosive power and speed: I love movements that are fast, reactive, and require sudden bursts of effort. | Precision and technical control: I thrive when the focus is on mastering specific, intricate, and refined motions. | Sustained endurance and mental grit: I feel most alive when pushing through long, challenging training blocks that demand focus and rhythm.]
Explosive power and speed: I love movements that are fast, reactive, and require sudden bursts of effort.

When you envision your high-performance athletic pathway, do you see yourself thriving more as an individual, or as a component of a high-energy collective?
Options: [Individual focus: I prefer the absolute clarity of testing myself against the clock or a set technical measurement. | Direct competition: I love the tension of one-on-one duels, where reading and reacting to an opponent's every move is the key. | Group dynamics: I find my rhythm in a team setting, where we combine our speed to execute complex, coordinated strategies.]
Individual focus: I prefer the absolute clarity of testing myself against the clock or a set technical measurement.

As you transition from your current training at 16 into your athletic prime at 22, what do you believe is the single most critical quality you need to cultivate to bridge that gap and compete at your absolute best?
Options: [Physical conditioning and recovery capacity: Building the durability to handle high-intensity, sustained explosive output. | Refinement of technique and micro-adjustments: Finding those fractional gains in speed and precision. | Mental resilience and performance under pressure: Mastering the nerves that come with the ultimate stage.]
Refinement of technique and micro-adjustments: Finding those fractional gains in speed and precision.
